detail.longDescription: I have been running Docker on my Linux (Debian) box for years. I have multiple containers and I have never had any issues. Recently (like the last few months), when my system reboots, all the containers start properly but they cannot access the internet. After some digging I learned its because the containers are not getting the resolve.conf from the host system. If I restart the containers after the server has been up for a few minutes, then the containers work properly. What would cause this? How can I debug and fix it?
